title: commitwork sitemap manifest v2
description: Per-project code-structure manifest for the SiteMap tab: services/containers -> file tree -> symbols (functions/classes/models/pages) + external links. Every node carries provenance {ast|heuristic|inventory|void} so an unparsed file can NEVER render as an empty (falsely clean) one — the never-imply-clean invariant. Generated by sitemap/build-fixture.mjs (S0 fixture) / monitor/sitemap-data.mjs (S2 live); consumed by sitemap/demo.html and the :7878 SiteMap tab. v2 (additive, backward-compatible) adds the 3D-city data layers: per-function span sizing, intra-service function-call wiring (roads), file-to-file import wiring, per-file logging counts (sewer), manifest-level airBridges (secure cross-service corridors resolved from io) and a vulnerabilities overlay (CVE glows keyed to container/file/function). Every v2 layer is ADDITIVE — a v1 consumer ignores them and a v2 consumer MUST degrade gracefully when any is absent; heuristic layers are stamped provenance:'heuristic' and are never parsed truth.

provenanceTier.description: ast = real parser (universal-ctags) extracted symbols; heuristic = pattern-derived (e.g. page-route detection); inventory = file identified by language only, symbols not extracted; void = present but unreadable/unparsed — MUST be surfaced, never hidden.

type.description: function | class | model (SQL table / JPA entity / proto / OpenAPI schema) | page | module | config

span.description: v2 — heuristic line window for function sizing. HEURISTIC estimate (ctags gives no block end): startLine = symbol line; endLine = (next same-file symbol's line - 1) or file end. NOT a parsed block boundary. Renderer sizes function blocks by (endLine - startLine + 1); absent => size 1.

type.description: dir | file | page | config (page/config are file refinements)

path.description: path relative to the service root

lang.description: language id (lowercase), e.g. java, typescript, sql, dockerfile

logging.description: v2 — heuristic logging/reporting profile for this file (the 'sewer' tap). Absent = zero sightings (rendered honestly as no tap, never as clean). Capped per file; overflow surfaced in truncation.droppedLogging.

category.description: 'audit' when >=1 call looks like a security/audit event (audit|security|login|authz|access-denied keywords); else 'app'. Heuristic — drives the audit-vs-app sewer split.

project.description: projSlug (lowercase), matching the panel's project picker — e.g. clientA

generated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the harvest run

ctags.description: ctags version string, or absent when the binary was unavailable (all files then cap at inventory tier)

fixture.description: true when this manifest is a demo fixture (subset of services), not a full-fleet harvest

provenance.description: Honest coverage rollup. files.void > 0 or any byLanguage tier below ast MUST be rendered as a visible badge, mirroring the panel's fresh/stale/never freshness pattern.

excluded.description: boundary entries (a skipped dir counts 1, contents unenumerated) dropped by the generator's gitignore-derived exclusion set — the harvest describes the product, not scan output parked inside it. Optional: pre-2026-08-21 manifests lack it.

path.description: path relative to the fleet root (e.g. services/svc-orders; 'buildout' for infra, '.' for a standalone repo)

lifecycle.description: absent = active. superseded = rollback standby (projects.json lifecycle, effectiveFrom-gated); retired = projects.json exclude. Consumers MUST render these dimmed-but-present — never blank, never clean.

container.description: null = no container definition found (a void worth seeing, not an error)

languages.description: language id -> file count within this service

io.description: I/O apertures — where the service opens to the outside world (endpoints, sockets, brokers, datastores, idp, outbound clients). ALL heuristic tier: pattern-derived from source/config with the source file attached so every claim is checkable; never parsed truth. Rendered as openings/transparency on the monolith visualization.

access.description: OPTIONAL access-control verdict for this aperture, attached by the report-reading layer (monitor/sitemap-overlays.mjs) from bin/authz-bola.mjs findings — never by the pure harvest engine. Absent = not probed (honest: a v1 manifest, or a fleet not yet booted/probed, simply omits it and the renderer draws nothing). Rendered by the demo as a black-glass sheet (F: black-glass blocked/bypassed I/O).

status.description: blocked=gated/unreachable-unauth; bypassed=reachable via defeated read control (authz-bola cross-tenant-read / header-trust / unauth-exposure); cross-tenant-write=another tenant could MUTATE this resource (integrity breach, more severe than bypassed); partial=gated one direction only; unknown=probed but indeterminate

direction.description: which flow the verdict applies to; 'partial' means the OTHER direction is open

detail.description: human-readable finding note (e.g. '2xx with no authentication')

source.description: report file the verdict came from, e.g. authz-bola.json

provenance.description: which scanner produced it; 'synthetic' only if ever demo-seeded (not currently)

wiring.description: v2 — intra-service function-call edges ('roads', permanent two-way highways). HEURISTIC tier: each function body (line..endLine) is scanned for identifiers matching OTHER known symbol names in the SAME service; a match emits a call edge. ctags gives no call graph, so this is pattern-derived and NEVER parsed truth — always provenance:'heuristic'. Self-edges and duplicates collapsed (weight = sighting count). Capped; overflow in truncation.droppedWiring. Empty array = scanned, nothing matched (honest, not clean).

file.description: service-relative path of the callee (may equal from.file)

weight.description: identifier sightings of callee inside caller body

fileWiring.description: v2 — file-to-file import/require edges ('wiring between files'). HEURISTIC scan of import/require/import-from statements and Java package refs resolved to a same-service file where possible. provenance:'heuristic'. Only edges whose target resolves to a file inside THIS service are kept (external deps live in io/externalLinks). Capped; overflow in truncation.droppedFileWiring.

logSinks.description: v2 — service-level rollup of the per-file `logging` counts (the 'sewer' system). Additive to per-file node.logging; lets the renderer size a service's drainage without walking the tree. Absent = no logging sightings anywhere in the service (rendered honestly). Mirrored at the manifest level as the top-level logSinks[] array.

calls.description: total logging call sightings (capped total = sum of node.logging.count)

audit.description: true when >=1 file in the service has audit-category logging

externalLinks.description: URLs harvested from source. UNTRUSTED input: consumers MUST escape on render and make clickable only ^https?:// with rel=noopener (bifocal F4).

logSinks.description: v2 — manifest-level rollup of the per-service logging profiles (the 'sewer' trunk lines). One entry per service that emits any logging, so the renderer can route trunk drainage without walking every tree. Derived from the per-file node.logging counts; audit=true when the service has >=1 audit-category logging file. Empty/absent = no logging anywhere (rendered honestly).

label.description: short human label, e.g. '42 logs · audit'

count.description: total logging call sites in the service

audit.description: true when the service has >=1 audit-category logging file

airBridges.description: v2 — manifest-level secure cross-service corridors ('air bridges'). RESOLVED from the existing per-service io apertures of the cross-service/secure kinds (grpc, amqp, kafka, oauth, client/feign) into service-to-service edges where an endpoint can be matched to a service. HEURISTIC: a feign client 'user-service' -> the service named *user-service; an amqp/kafka publisher -> listener(s) of the same broker/exchange when inferable; oauth -> the resolved idp service if present. Endpoints that do not resolve are kept as dangling edges (to:null) — NEVER dropped silently (never-imply-clean). Renderer draws a corridor per edge; dangling edges render as a bridge to open air.

to.description: target service id, or null when the endpoint could not be resolved (dangling — shown, not hidden)

kind.description: secure/cross-service io kind this corridor was resolved from

endpoint.description: the io detail that seeded this edge (feign name, exchange/topic, service name, idp)

resolved.description: true = to != null via a matched service; false = dangling

count.description: io sightings that seeded this corridor

vulnerabilities.description: v2 — CVE/vulnerability overlay for the 3D city glows. Each entry pins a finding to the FINEST node scope it can honestly reach: container (trivy image scans — attach to no source line), file or function (source scanners semgrep/codeql with file:line, resolved to the symbol whose span contains the line). Severity drives the glow colour (critical=dark red, high=orange, medium=yellow, low=dim — stacking glows). A finding that cannot be pinned below container scope KEEPS scope:'container' — a file/function location is NEVER fabricated. source names the scanner; provenance is 'inventory' for trivy package findings (parsed from a real SBOM scan, but not tied to source AST) and 'ast'/'heuristic' for source-scoped findings per the scanner. Capped per severity/target; overflow in truncation.droppedVulns. An empty array means the scan ran and found nothing to overlay (honest) — absence of the whole field means no scan artifact was available.

service.description: service id the target belongs to (present for all scopes when known — lets the renderer find the building even for a container-scope image finding, and resolve file/function position)

ref.description: scope=container: image ref string (e.g. quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.7.0) or service id; scope=file: service-relative path string; scope=function: object {file:<service-relative path>, symbol:<function name>}

fixed.description: fixed version, or absent when no fix is published

title.description: short human title (UNTRUSTED scanner text — consumers MUST escape on render)

chain.description: OTHER vulnerability ids this one links to (shared package / same CWE cluster) — renderer draws connections on mouseover

truncation.description: Present whenever any cap was applied (no silent caps — house rule). Absent = nothing dropped.

droppedWiring.description: v2 — function-call edges dropped by the per-service wiring cap

droppedFileWiring.description: v2 — import edges dropped by the per-service fileWiring cap

droppedLogging.description: v2 — logging sightings dropped by the per-file logging cap

droppedVulns.description: v2 — vulnerability entries dropped by the overlay cap
